description: Block inventory mapping source AEM components (aaaem-* / cmp-*) to EDS blocks for the juvederm.nl migration.

contentModel.description: Full-width hero banner with background media and heading overlay.

cells: Background image (or poster frame for video)

variants: hero-video — homepage hero with looping background video + image fallback
hero-image — treatment/faq/locator hero with background image only
blocks.notes: Source uses aaaem-teaser with classes: hero-teaser, has-media, has-full-bleed-image, has-video, scroll-effect-none. Video variant only on homepage. Images served via Adobe Dynamic Media (dm-aid URLs) — will need re-hosting or path mapping. Always the first content element on a page.

contentModel.description: Sliding carousel with dot indicators. Each row is one slide. Content per slide varies by variant.

cells: Slide content: image(s) and/or text depending on variant

variants: before-after — two images per slide with 'Voor'/'Na' labels (homepage)
text-only — single paragraph of benefit text per slide (treatment, faq)
product-cards — card with background image + title + description per slide (treatment)
blocks.notes: Source uses 'carouselslide' container style class per item. Items are often duplicated (mobile/desktop variants in source — EDS version should be responsive with a single set). Homepage has 10 items (5 unique before/after pairs). Treatment benefit carousel has 6 items (3 unique). Product card carousel has 10 items (5 unique products). Needs touch/swipe support and dot indicators.

contentModel.description: Grid of cards. Each row defines one card.

variants: text-only — no image, title + body text only (homepage benefit cards, 4 cards)
product — background image + title + description (treatment product cards)
blocks.notes: Text-only variant on homepage shows 4 value-proposition cards in a horizontal row. Product variant on treatment pages has background images from Dynamic Media. Often rendered inside a carousel on treatment pages (product-cards carousel variant). The 'card' container style class wraps these in source AEM.

contentModel.description: Expandable/collapsible FAQ pairs. Each row is one Q&A item.

cells: Cell 1: Question text (becomes the clickable heading)

blocks.notes: Used on treatment pages for FAQ section. Typically 4 items per page. Often paired with an adjacent image on the left side (the image is outside the accordion block, in the same section). Standard expand/collapse with toggle icon.

contentModel.description: Interactive face portrait with toggling text panels for different treatment zones. Each row defines one zone.

cells: Cell 1: Zone label (e.g., 'Versterk contouren', 'Stralende oogopslag', 'Herstel volume', 'Vollere lippen')

blocks.notes: Complex interactive component. Source uses visibility toggling via style classes on aaaem-container children. Has 4 zones: contouren, ogen, volume, lippen. Uses two Dynamic Media images (female and male portraits). Shared across homepage and treatment pages (was an AEM experience fragment). Needs custom JS for tab-like toggling behavior. Consider implementing as a tabs-style interaction with image swap.

contentModel.description: Sticky anchor navigation for FAQ page sections. Each row is one anchor link.

blocks.notes: Used only on the FAQ page. Source has 'Zoek op onderwerp' placeholder text and renders as a dropdown/filter navigation. In EDS, implement as a sticky horizontal nav bar with smooth-scroll to anchor IDs. Topics: Over Juvéderm®, Kosten, Langdurige resultaten, Veiligheid, Zones van het gezicht.

contentModel.description: Clinic finder search interface with location input. Single-row block with configuration.

cells: Cell 2: Input placeholder text (e.g., 'Zoek op postcode, plaatsnaam')
Cell 1: Google Places API key or config reference

blocks.notes: Heavy custom JS block. Source uses Google Places autocomplete (pac-container detected). Has responsive desktop/mobile input variants in source. Needs Google Maps/Places JS API integration. Search submits to a results page (/nl/clinics). Consider whether to replicate full search or simplify to a form that redirects. This is the most complex custom block in the migration.

contentModel.description: Two-column layout for text + image side-by-side sections.

variants: before-after — two images with Voor/Na labels (treatment pages)
text-image — text on left, image on right (intro sections)
blocks.notes: Maps from aaaem-container with 'scroll-reveal-before-sibling' style class. Used for intro-text-with-image sections on homepage and treatment pages. The before/after variant on treatment pages shows a static image pair (not in carousel). Can use EDS boilerplate columns block.

cells: Cell 1: Embed URL or video URL

blocks.notes: Source has 'c-find-the-clinic-video' container (likely a video embed or CTA) and aaaem-embed for tracking. The video container appears on homepage and treatment pages. May be partially client-side rendered in source. Evaluate whether tracking embeds need migration or should be replaced with EDS-native analytics.

defaultContent.description: These source AEM components map to plain EDS default content (standard HTML elements rendered by aem.js) and do NOT require custom blocks.

mappings.notes: Most common component. Includes body copy, footnotes, disclaimers, references. Footnotes/references should use <small> or a dedicated CSS class for fine-print styling.
Section headings. Source supports alignment variants (default, center). Center alignment can be handled via section metadata or inline style.
Standalone images. Source uses Adobe Dynamic Media URLs with lazy loading. EDS will use standard <picture> with srcset for responsive images. Some images have links (wrapped in <a>).

Three visual styles in source: primary-filled (coral/pink), primary-outline (outlined), secondary-filled (dark). In EDS, use standard button class with variants via .button.primary, .button.secondary, .button.outline defined in styles.css.

Layout containers become EDS sections. Style variants like 'scroll-reveal-before-sibling' map to section metadata classes. Not all container variants need migration — many are purely structural in AEM.

header.edsImplementation: nav.html auto-generated from /nav document in content source
header.notes: EDS uses a /nav document to define header navigation. Mega-menu with two dropdown sections (Behandeling, Q&A) plus a 'Vind je kliniek' CTA. Mobile hamburger menu is handled by EDS header block JS. Logo links to /nl homepage.

footer.edsImplementation: footer.html auto-generated from /footer document in content source
footer.notes: EDS uses a /footer document. Contains: warning message with icon ('Kijk uit...'), legal text, nav links (treatments + Q&A topics), social media links (Instagram, Facebook), legal links (privacy, terms, disclaimer, cookies, clinic finder terms), Juvéderm + Allergan logos. Cookie settings link triggers OneTrust banner.

sectionStyles.name: scroll-reveal
sectionStyles.description: Scroll-triggered reveal animation for content sections
sectionStyles.implementation: CSS animation triggered via IntersectionObserver in scripts.js

sectionStyles.name: centered
sectionStyles.description: Center-aligned text content (used on legal and contact pages)

sectionStyles.name: footer-notes
sectionStyles.description: Small-print reference/footnote styling at bottom of pages
sectionStyles.implementation: Section metadata style: footnotes — applies smaller font size and muted color

buttonStyles.primary-outline: Transparent background, coral/pink border and text

designTokens.imageDelivery: Adobe Dynamic Media — URLs follow pattern: /adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--{uuid}/{filename}. Query params: ?preferwebp=true&quality=85&width={w}. Images need to be migrated to DA.live or kept as external references.
